title: Ext cocycles and section homology under an arbitrary comparison
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $J$ its Zariski topology [def-sc-zariski-site], $K$ its small etale topology [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and $i:X.\mathrm{Opens}\to X.\mathrm{Etale}$ a continuous functor [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Assume abelian sheafification and Ext on both sites. Put $G=i_*$ and let $F$ be an abelian etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], $I$ an injective resolution of $F$ and $R$ an injective resolution of $GF$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Let $b:R\to GI$ be any cochain map, $q\ge0$, and $V\in X.\mathrm{Opens}$. For any site object $W$, put $P(W)$ equal to the sheafification of the free abelian presheaf on its representable; evaluating a sheaf morphism from $P(W)$ at the identity generator gives its section over $W$. There are additive equivalences $e_1:H^q(V,GF)\simeq H^q(R(V))$ and $e_2:H^q(i(V),F)\simeq H^q((GI)(V))$ with this property: for any cocycles $a:P(V)\to R^q$ and $c:P(i(V))\to I^q$, if $b^q(V)$ sends the section of $a$ to the section of $c$, then $e_2([c])=H^q(b(V))(e_1([a]))$. Here $[a]$ and $[c]$ are the Ext classes computed from the indicated injective resolutions. There is no augmentation condition on $b$ and no hypothesis on inverse image.

proof.text: Apply the single-site normalized equivalence to R at V and to I at i(V), obtaining e₁ and e₂ and their formulas on all extMk cocycles. Evaluation of pushforward at V is definitionally evaluation at i(V).

Rewrite both Ext classes with the normalization formulas. The assumed equality of sections says that the evaluated chain map sends the first cycle to the second. Apply the generalized zariski_etale_resolution_cocycle_compatibility to these cycles and take the symmetry of its homology-class equality.

theorem zariski_etale_resolution_cocycle_homology
    {X : Scheme.{u + 1}}
    (i : X.Opens ⥤ X.Etale)
    (hi : i.IsContinuous (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
      X.smallEtaleTopology)
    [HasSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    [HasSheafify X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    [HasExt
      (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [HasExt (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (R : InjectiveResolution ((i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).obj F))
    (b : R.cocomplex ⟶
      ((i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex)
    (q : ℕ) (V : X.Opens) :
    ∃ (e₁ : Sheaf.H' ((i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).obj F) q V ≃+
        ↑(HomologicalComplex.homology
          (((sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⋙
            (evaluation X.Opensᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (op V)).mapHomologicalComplex
               (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj R.cocomplex) q))
      (e₂ : Sheaf.H' F q (i.obj V) ≃+
        ↑(HomologicalComplex.homology
          (((sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⋙
            (evaluation X.Opensᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (op V)).mapHomologicalComplex
               (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj
                (((i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
                  (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
                    X.smallEtaleTopology).mapHomologicalComplex
                       (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex)) q)),
      ∀ (a : (presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
        (yoneda.obj V ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free) ⟶ R.cocomplex.X q)
        (ha : a ≫ R.cocomplex.d q (q + 1) = 0)
        (c : (presheafToSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
        (yoneda.obj (i.obj V) ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free) ⟶ I.cocomplex.X q)
        (hc : c ≫ I.cocomplex.d q (q + 1) = 0),
        (b.f q).hom.app (op V) ((a.hom.app (op V)).hom
          (((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
            (yoneda.obj V ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free)).app (op V)).hom
              (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 V)))) =
        ((c.hom.app (op (i.obj V))).hom
          (((toSheafify X.smallEtaleTopology
            (yoneda.obj (i.obj V) ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free)).app (op (i.obj V))).hom
              (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 (i.obj V))))) →
        e₂ (I.extMk c (q + 1) rfl hc) =
        (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (((sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⋙
            (evaluation X.Opensᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (op V)).mapHomologicalComplex
               (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map b) q).hom (e₁ (R.extMk a (q + 1) rfl ha))
